content.title: Editorial Fashion Type | Built Space, Portrait Grid and Lockup
content.summary: An adult architect drives tram, building, portrait-grid and letter-fragment modules into a GRID / IN MOTION lockup. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult identity and at least four appearance anchors precede every interface module. + Each module is triggered by one visible body or headphone action and introduces no more than one exact short word. + Waveform, control ring, play bar and fragments remain one coherent graphic system. + Boot and portrait-grid proofs verify the same character before the terminal movement. + The final lockup reunites the adult, settled fragments, recurring rings and one readable original master mark.
quick_start.recommended_input: Open on one original clearly adult editorial architect with an auburn wave, straight fringe, mint checked suit and one silver square earring reflected in a tram window beside the exact black title "GRID". Use one three-pose silhouette card for identity proof, then bind a forward lean to the exact word "BUILD" and a quarter-turn to "ALIGN" inside separate cream-and-black layouts. Gather the architect, silver square and checked pattern into one still black-and-copper master lockup reading exactly "GRID / IN MOTION"; hold every letter readable and stop all fragments.
required_anchors: One clearly adult identity and at least four face, hair, wardrobe and accessory anchors precede all layout changes.
Every module binds one readable pose or movement to no more than one new exact short word.
Vehicle, building and typography cards remain modules of one campaign through recurring color and shape anchors.
The final lockup reunites the complete adult and original master mark in one readable still frame.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult architect drives tram, building, portrait-grid and letter-fragment modules into a GRID / IN MOTION lockup. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 锁定同一成年金发模特的脸、发型、粉格西装和金色耳饰，让巨型字母、车镜、姿态组、圆环短词、建筑剪影和编号肖像逐模块响应人物动作；终局必须把完整人物和原创主标收拢到同一静止版式。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult identity and at least four face, hair, wardrobe and accessory anchors precede all layout changes.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult identity and at least four face, hair, wardrobe and accessory anchors precede all layout changes."

invariants.rule: Every module binds one readable pose or movement to no more than one new exact short word.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Every module binds one readable pose or movement to no more than one new exact short word."

invariants.rule: Portrait grids and silhouettes re-verify the same adult instead of introducing alternate identities.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Portrait grids and silhouettes re-verify the same adult instead of introducing alternate identities."

invariants.rule: Vehicle, building and typography cards remain modules of one campaign through recurring color and shape anchors.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Vehicle, building and typography cards remain modules of one campaign through recurring color and shape anchors."

invariants.rule: The final lockup reunites the complete adult and original master mark in one readable still frame.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final lockup reunites the complete adult and original master mark in one readable still frame."

the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
